title: Rico — BankDiamond.flash() Arbitrary transferFrom Execution Analysis
root_cause: The `BankDiamond.flash()` function forwards `transferFrom`-encoded callback data to the token contract without validation, allowing the attacker to unauthorized transfer token balances from specific token holders
steps: → [2] Same pattern to drain LINK, wstETH, WETH
→ [3] Drained tokens → swapped for USDC (Uniswap V3)
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] BankDiamond.flash(ARB, 0, attacker, transferFromData)
  │         └─ data = abi.encode(transferFrom, victim, attacker, victimBal)
  │         └─ ARB.call(data) → transferFrom executed
  │         └─ victim's ARB → transferred to attacker
  │
  ├─→ [2] Same pattern to drain LINK, wstETH, WETH
  │
  ├─→ [3] Drained tokens → swapped for USDC (Uniswap V3)
  │
  └─→ [4] ~$36K stolen
